title: Gates M0 to M4 are ordered, not timed; lane sessions stop after M0
context: The hackathon length is unknown. The user asked to start several sessions and have them test the setup before building.
decision: Milestones are ordered gates: M0 setup verified, M1 contracts frozen, M2 vertical slice, M3 real inputs, M4 demo-ready. Each lane session's first task is the M0 checklist in its brief: claim, prove the edit guard, write PLAN.md, log a kickoff decision, message neighbours, post status, push, then stop and report. Building M1 starts when a person says go. Clock times get attached once the schedule is known.
alternatives: Let sessions start building immediately: burns time if the setup or the plan needs correcting
consequences: Lane status phase uses M0 to M4, which drives the gate strip on the dashboard.
author: claude (coord)
